description: Land Acquisition - Gonnoruwa, Hambantota D/S Division, Hambantota District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically detailing the acquisition of multiple land lots for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of land parcels, their locations, extents, current uses, and claimants. The content falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisitions and property matters, not government personnel/structure or other specialized categories.
